supported: The patch preserves existing occupied content: it repairs only status=pending/content=[] on the same conversation and position and refuses conflicts, rather than writing from request_snapshot during resume.

The assistant readback precedes dispatch, and the tool readback precedes tool_delegated. Missing assistant checkpoint captures safe status/count metadata and raises on unresolved conflict or failed repair.

The two checks serve distinct call sites, but call-id extraction and row validation are duplicated rather than one shared readiness primitive; this is a maintenance concern, not evidence of this incident failing.

important_finding.finding: The new test invokes _ensure_assistant_tool_use_on_disk and _execute_delegated separately, with monkeypatched message reads, queue update, coordinator finalize, and tool ledger. It does not execute the orchestrator predicate, real queued flush, or authoritative end-to-end continuation. Therefore it cannot fail on the missed-predicate or zero-row write class implicated by the incident. No unit RED-before-GREEN was demonstrated; the live pre-fix 409 is the independent RED.
